evidence.note: The pinned /DomainInfo/domains_data responses/200/content/application~1json/schema/properties/result/properties/data oneOf references HashOutput and ListOutput. ListOutput omits the array container, whereas parameter format=list and examples/list/value/data explicitly contain a list. HashOutput main_domain describes items while examples/hash/value/data/addon_domains/2/main_domain is an object. The effective contract retains both documented containers and the explicit example object. Components Contents and MainDomainContents supply optional row fields; list examples additionally supply options, numeric-string port, string flags, customlog/scriptalias lists, and separate parked redirect name lists. Parked domain names also occur as strings in the hash example. These are pinned documentation discrepancies, not live observations.

notes.text: Returns a hash of domain-type containers or a list according to format. User-data files can omit any documented field. Explicit null IPv6 remains null. Pinned prose/schema and examples disagree on several containers; the effective shape preserves the documented hash/list variants and example log/alias lists.

Quoted 0/1 domain flags and port values normalize to integers. The documented empty-string userdirprotect value stays an empty string, distinct from 0; other nonflag strings remain invalid. Shared flag fields use the same wire compatibility across record kinds and singleDomainData().
Only query an account-owned main, addon or subdomain; aliases have no user-data file and must be queried through their associated main or addon domain. Any documented result field may be omitted.

The pinned parameter name is return_https_redirect_status (singular redirect); some return descriptions incorrectly use return_https_redirects_status. The request uses the declared singular parameter. Hiding a requested temporary domain causes an API error.

Observed customlog and scriptalias may be lists as well as the pinned objects. Quoted 0/1 hascgi and phpopenbasedirprotect flags normalize to integers, as do lossless integer port strings. Unknown fields remain outside the contract.

Shared domain flags accept the quoted 0/1 forms documented by the domains_data examples. The userdirprotect empty-string variant is preserved without mapping it to 0; other nonflag strings remain invalid. Optional fields remain omitted when absent.
